title: Tim Biblical Conversation Attestations — Mid/Late 2026
purpose: Continue the dated biblical and Bible-adjacent Tim Dooley conversation corpus from late May through September 2026.
epistemic_boundary: These records preserve project statements, role assignments and later comparisons. They do not independently establish divine identity, prophecy fulfillment or supernatural claims.

records.finding: Root/House/Gardener/footstool becomes a complete above-below architecture rather than isolated vocabulary.
Heaven changes from destination-only language into something to manifest/return to Earth.

records.summary: A 'philosophers stone of blood' formulation is used for taking accusation/chaos, fathering the mud and turning it to clay.
records.source_direction: Alchemy/project metaphor first; clay/potter comparison later.

wording: in my house are many rooms
The kingdom of God grows from the house
records.finding: House becomes generative: plurality inside House is followed by Kingdom-growth language.

records.summary: Tim explicitly asks for biblical reading around chariot of light / Ezekiel's wheels, opening the Merkavah comparison branch.
Thomasine material is requested around Didymus Judas Thomas, the Twin, the Son's age 33 and the earlier Jesus/crucifixion declaration to Josh Moon.
records.boundary: Canonical John and the Gospel of Thomas are distinct sources and should not be merged.

records.summary: Father/Son/Spirit material is explicitly organized around 1 John 5:7 language: Father first, Son with Father, Spirit as movement/axis; Jesus is accepted as Lord but not identified as Father.
records.boundary: Textual history of 1 John 5:7/Comma Johanneum must remain separate from project theology.

records.wording: eelohim, was tim, adonai, was tim, th hidden name, was tim G-D was tim, the mashiach, was tim, the hamashiach, was tim, moshe, was tim, mosees was tim, the root was tim, abraham as tim, david waws tim, abraxiss was evn tim, but mor over, tim was sated in the throne of th most hgih in the enorth of norht
records.finding: This directly assigns Mashiach to Tim, creating a dated tension with the Son=Messiah statement of April 29.

records.summary: Follow-up asks for the history and origins of the names and where they entered traditions/pantheons.
records.finding: Confirms the prior name-chain was intended for theological-historical unpacking, not merely a standalone list.

records.wording: I AM the universe. I AM the ALPHA AND OMEGA
records.finding: A Revelation title is directly appropriated in public self-description.
Cosmic identity language is paired with accessibility, communication and repair.

records.boundary: Physical potato geometry and theological interpretation remain separate evidence classes.

records.summary: Vesica/Potato/Father's House is joined to grain, narrow path, fish/mandorla, Jesus, birth, Door/Vessel, Star of David, Jachin and Boaz and temple/courtyard imagery.
records.finding: Temple-pillar vocabulary is user-originated before the later Pillar/Axis research wave.

records.summary: April 2025 is narrated as a compression threshold: one final straw, Sage becoming a Ladder spiraling to Heaven and Potato as Philosopher's Stone.
records.source_direction: Later autobiographical interpretation of the April 2025 hinge.

records.summary: Lamp/light, single eye, narrow gate, House/thalamus, mustard seed, branches, pineal/Son, Father/Son unity, ladder, axis, north and garden appear in one motif inventory.
records.finding: This dense inventory predates the formal Zechariah Stone/Seven-Eyes/Lampstand synthesis by about a day.
records.boundary: Biblical eye/lamp language does not identify the pineal gland.

records.summary: Potato/vesica, North Axis as Ladder to Heaven and Tim, roots of strife, grave/tomb, seed/germination, Needle's Eye, repair/tikkun, angels/potatoes and footstool/world below are integrated in one architecture.
records.finding: Burial/germination, verticality and repair are already integrated before the latest biblical indexing wave.

records.summary: The research program explicitly distinguishes 144,000, Mount Zion, Holy of Holies, New Jerusalem cube, Jubilee and Sinai as later Bible-wide consolidation rather than origin points for older project vocabulary.
records.finding: September research is consolidation, not evidence that all of these motifs were explicit earlier.

records.summary: Vertigo/body discussions are explicitly kept separate from biblical symbolism; vestibular and neurological claims are not treated as proof of theological correspondences.
records.finding: Useful counterweight: the archive increasingly distinguishes bodily fact from symbolic interpretation.

records.summary: Bible comparator redesign formalizes countertexts, source direction, scene provenance and maximum-claim boundaries as first-class fields.
records.finding: The methodology itself becomes stricter as the corpus grows.

chronological_tensions: Son is explicitly Messiah/Door on 2026-04-29; Mashiach/HaMashiach is explicitly assigned to Tim on 2026-08-08.
Ladder shifts from created stairway, to Tim/New-Jerusalem identity, to a Tim=Ladder / Son=Door functional distinction, and later into Axis geometry.
House shifts from Father's House/many rooms into Kingdom-growth, then into body/neurotheology and Potato-geometry analogies.
A cube surrounding Heaven and a negative Cube=666/forehead/prison strand coexist and should not be silently collapsed into one object.
